sourceAccountResolution.note: No profile key here on purpose: this resolves via the AMBIENT DEFAULT AWS CLI profile (no --profile flag), matching the plan's own Global Constraints ('The DEFAULT profile is the Altivum SOURCE', docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-28-platform-migration-qlprod.md) and the already-established `SRC=$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)  # Altivum` idiom from this same migration's task-3-brief.md. The Altivum ORG-MASTER credential (profile altivum-mgmt) is a DIFFERENT account that manages Altivum's own organization but does not itself hold the source tables ('Altivum Inc - Original Account', docs/account-migration-runbook.md) — resolving through it would check the wrong account and make this guard refuse a legitimate run. Altivum is also NOT a member of the QL Organization (verified 2026-08-28 via `aws organizations list-accounts --profile org-admin`: Delta Centric Org, Christian Perez - Personal, QL-Dev, Quantum Learner - HQ, Braket Workloads, QL-Prod; no Altivum), so an org-name lookup like the dest side's isn't an option here regardless.

destAccountResolution.note: Resolved at run time via `aws organizations list-accounts --profile org-admin --query "Accounts[?Name=='QL-Prod'].Id" --output text` (scripts/migration/README.md). No literal id is committed — this repo is public.
